    private static final String
    ORDER_COUNT_SQL
    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_timestamp >= ? AND order_timestamp < ? AND LOWER(status) = \'completed\'"
    private static final String
    USAGE_SQL
    "SELECT inv.name, inv.unit, SUM(oi.quantity * ri.quantity_required) AS used, inv.current_stock FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN recipe_ingredient ri ON ri.menu_item_id = oi.menu_item_id JOIN inventory_item inv ON inv.inventory_item_id = ri.inventory_item_id WHERE o.order_timestamp >= ? AND o.order_timestamp < ? AND LOWER(o.status) = \'completed\' GROUP BY inv.inventory_item_id, inv.name, inv.unit, inv.current_stock ORDER BY inv.unit, used DESC, inv.name"
  • gui.gui.SalesReportPanel
    Modifier and Type
    Constant Field
    Value
    private static final String
    SALES_SQL
    "SELECT m.name, m.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN menu_item m ON m.menu_item_id = oi.menu_item_id WHERE o.order_timestamp >= ? AND o.order_timestamp < ? AND LOWER(o.status) = \'completed\' AND (CAST(? AS VARCHAR) IS NULL OR m.category = ?) GROUP BY m.menu_item_id, m.name, m.category ORDER BY sales DESC, m.name"

    private static final String
    HOURLY_SQL
    "WITH day AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_timestamp >= ? AND order_timestamp < ?) , items AS (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_item oi JOIN day d ON d.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY oi.order_id) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM d.order_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\'), COALESCE(SUM(i.qty) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(d.subtotal) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(d.tax) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(d.tip) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(d.total) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\'), 0), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(d.status) <> \'completed\') FROM day d LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id = d.order_id GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour"
    private static final String
    PAYMENT_SQL
    "WITH day AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_timestamp >= ? AND order_timestamp < ?) SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*), SUM(total) FROM day WHERE LOWER(status) = \'completed\' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC"
    private static final String
    STATUS_SQL
    "WITH day AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_timestamp >= ? AND order_timestamp < ?) SELECT status, COUNT(*), SUM(total) FROM day GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC"
    private static final String
    TOP_ITEM_SQL
    "WITH day AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_timestamp >= ? AND order_timestamp < ?) SELECT m.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM day d JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = d.order_id JOIN menu_item m ON m.menu_item_id = oi.menu_item_id WHERE LOWER(d.status) = \'completed\' GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1"
    private static final String
    TOTALS_SQL
    "WITH day AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_timestamp >= ? AND order_timestamp < ?) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = \'completed\'), COALESCE(SUM(subtotal) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(tax) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(tip) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = \'completed\'), 0), COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = \'completed\'), 0), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) <> \'completed\'), COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) <> \'completed\'), 0) FROM day"
